ValidationRule.description: Sync counts and charged API requests are nonnegative whole values and terminal outcomes cannot exceed received input.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(Received_Count__c < 0, Mapped_Count__c < 0, Failed_Count__c < 0, Salesforce_Request_Count__c < 0, Received_Count__c <> FLOOR(Received_Count__c), Mapped_Count__c <> FLOOR(Mapped_Count__c), Failed_Count__c <> FLOOR(Failed_Count__c), Salesforce_Request_Count__c <> FLOOR(Salesforce_Request_Count__c), Mapped_Count__c + Failed_Count__c > Received_Count__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Sync counts must be coherent nonnegative whole numbers.
